description: Which block was the chain on at a given moment: give a date-time or unix timestamp and get the last block mined at or before it, with its exact time and hash and the first block after it. Use it to turn "balance on 1 November" or "events since yesterday" into block numbers for other calls. Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon. $0.003. Costs $0.003 USDC per call (x402).
name: evm_block_by_time
title: evm block by time
